transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get started on the weekly training synchronization. I'll need roster updates, qualification status, scheduling conflicts, and facility availability before I publish next week's training schedule. Who wants to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Ma'am, my roster audit completed this morning shows that exactly five of the eight Transport operators lack current vehicle-recovery-equipment qualification and must attend the recertification block. The other three are already qualified. I should note the updated roster has not yet been entered in the training tracker, so I wanted to get this in front of you now so it's reflected when you publish the schedule.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Ma'am, I have a facility conflict to flag. I confirmed this morning that the Generator Training Pad is reserved for calibration work on Wednesday from 0900 to 1300. That means the Generator Section's load-bank session cannot use the recurring Wednesday 0900 to 1100 slot. It needs to be moved to Monday from 1300 to 1500 instead. I should also note that the facility calendar still shows the old recurring Wednesday slot, so it hasn't been updated yet to reflect the calibration reservation.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Thank you both. SFC Morgan, good catch on the Transport qualifications — so five of eight Transport operators need the vehicle-recovery recertification block. I'll make sure that's reflected when I publish. WO1 Patel, noted on the Generator Training Pad conflict — Wednesday 0900 to 1300 is taken by calibration work, so we'll need to move the Generator load-bank session. You're recommending Monday 1300 to 1500 as the alternate slot. Before I lock that in, does anyone have a conflict with Monday afternoon? I also want to confirm the Generator Training Pad is available during that Monday window. Any other updates I need before I publish?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Ma'am, I don't have any conflicts on my end for Monday afternoon. The five unqualified Transport operators are the ones who need Tuesday's vehicle-recovery recertification block, and the three qualified operators can be excused from that session. I'll get the updated roster entered into the training tracker as soon as we wrap up here. No other updates from me at this time.
transcript.speaker: A2
